theory: The ratio constant in $P/(C-P)=Ae^{kt}$ and the denominator constant in $P=C/(1+Ae^{-kt})$ are reciprocals, not the same constant. Use distinct names consistently in facts and steps, as the booklet does at lines 3160–3161. State $k>0$, $C>0$ and the relevant positive initial population assumptions: convergence to $C$ excludes $P_0=0$, while the claim of never reaching $C$ excludes $P_0=C$; the formula for the initial denominator constant requires $P_0>0$. The S-shaped inflection statement applies to solutions with $0<P_0<C$, with a future inflection only when $P_0<C/2$.
